dedupe_keys.name: 全国道路施設点検テータヘース japan national road facility inspection database bridges tunnels pavement road attachments earthworks

description: The national road facility inspection database is MLIT's shared system for the specifications and inspection results of Japan's road structures, part of the xROAD road data platform. The xROAD entry read on 2026-09-28 says road administrators use it to register, search, view and download data without running their own systems, can see inspection results of facilities managed by others, and that research institutes and companies can obtain the aggregated opened data through a user interface or API for analysis, AI diagnosis and other uses; sample data are offered for bridges, tunnels, pavement, road attachments and earthworks. The portal read the same day requires agreeing to terms per service, offers database and public API use by application, a free damage map for public browsing, and a notice of 28 July 2026 that the basic facility data service for non-road administrators, stopped since November 2024, has resumed. Coverage is national. Access is free, with application; the terms were not read in full. Caveats: service pauses are frequent and field definitions vary by facility type. It supports condition-based fragility and resilience studies of Japanese bridges and tunnels. Related records: data-japan-ksj-roads-n01 and data-mlit-disaster-portal-lifeline-information complement it.
